text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I heard all about it, Shion-san!
I hear you did amazing in the mock race!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! ...Sir!
I was feeling way better than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Still... everyone really is strong.
They've got talents I don't, and I'm honestly jealous."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~, I get that.
Like that razor-sharp final kick or that relentless, grittiness stamina.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I really want a "weapon," you know~?
Something to hold my own against that sparkly genius-chan.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A weapon... A weapon, huh...
What do I even have?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature and Shion spotted~~!
Hey, hey, you two come play with Turbo and the others!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Demon♪ Follow the clapping hands♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...! Over here, maybee~~...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. I spotted Win Variation
hanging out with other Umamusume,
so I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's blind man's bluff!
We take turns being 'it' and compete to see who catches the most people!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The 'it' closes their eyes and tries to catch people by following the sound of claps,
but it's actually pretty tough."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Is Shion's Trainer interested too?
We can let you join Turbo's crew!
choice_data_list: Fufu, thank you. All right then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, closing my eyes, I tried playing the role of the seeker, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Demon♪ Follow the clapping hands♪
choice_data_list: (This way? But it's kinda scary to keep going...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems Shion-san's Trainer
didn't achieve very favorable results either.
choice_data_list: Being the 'it' is harder than I thought...
Being the 'it' is harder than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? Even if you know the direction,
it's surprisingly hard to walk in a straight line.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Shion-san, you're the next 'it'.
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ouss! I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Demon♪ Follow the clapping hands♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is it this way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Closing her eyes, Win Variation began to walk.
Just as I thought she might struggle as well..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Step, step, step...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ei!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: There!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation caught up to and tagged the Umamusume one after another.
Her footwork was steady and solid.
choice_data_list: I wonder how they can walk so briskly...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! That voice... She's over this way!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, caught ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, the "it" who caught the most people that day was Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, carrot juice is on me
for our winner, Shion-san~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing~? Even with her eyes closed, she's like,
*shuta-shuta*~~... *mun!*

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... is it really that impressive?
If it's a place I'm used to,
I can walk around even with my eyes closed...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fantastico!!
Shion-san, che talento!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You can definitely show off that quality!
As an "eyes-closed style Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: No way! That's a wonderful talent!
Maybe we can make use of this in training?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Talent... Is it really about talent...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
…………Huh, what's this?
What is this thing...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's a little hot... maybe... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, for real!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, leveraging Win Variation's special talents,
I prepared a training routine designed to hone
her senses, balance, and coordination.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I thought walking with my eyes closed wouldn't really help in a race, but...
choice_data_list: I think there are skills that only you can hone, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because it's me—...!
Yessir, I'll do my very best...!"
